title: AI inference startup General Compute gets a $400M loan from tech investment firm Upper90, seemingly the first deal to use inference-specific chips as collateral (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim Fernholz / TechCrunch: AI inference startup General Compute gets a $400M loan from tech investment firm Upper90, seemingly the first deal to use inference-specific chips as collateral — General Compute, an AI inference cloud startup, has landed a $400 million loan from Upper90, a tech investment firm.
